chunks: He prayed: "O my Lord, help me against them, for they accuse me of lies."

key_terms.كَذَّبُونِ: They accuse me of lies / They deny me

ai.seo_question: What was Noah's prayer when his people denied him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as the Prophet Noah (peace be upon him) invoking divine assistance specifically through the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt or the ultimate victory of the Imams, linking his struggle to the broader narrative of prophetic endurance. It underscores the concept of 'nasr' (victory) not merely as military success but as the triumph of truth over persistent denial, a theme central to the Shia understanding of the struggle against injustice.
